messages:
mia_cs: FYI NewCo emailed asking to onboard a custom doc-summarizer model for multi-lang PDFs (en/es/pt). They need HIPAA/PHI-safe hosting + HSM for keys and p95 latency <= 250ms for short docs. Renewal in ~2 months; customer flagged as at-risk if we can't meet perf/cost.
jordan_se: Thanks — can you paste model artifact format/size? Also what's their qps profile?
mia_cs: Artifact is torchscript export ~7.2GB. Expect steady 40 qps with spikes to ~120 for ~30s. Wants per-tenant isolation + audit logs. They also require page-aware summaries that preserve tables.
sam_modelops: Hosting note: PHI+HSM points to Private VPC with KMS/HSM. For 40 qps and 250ms p95 we'll benchmark both FP16 and int8. Initial thought: int8 quant + batching could hit targets on 3x A100-40GB equiv. If FP16 enforced, cost ~2.5x.
lee_pm: Product note: we don't have an OOB PDF page-aware chunker that preserves tables. We can adapt the summarizer pipeline but need ~1 sprint to harden and add table extraction. Does the customer require table extraction at acceptance?
mia_cs: Yes — they called it out as must-have. Also asked for an evaluation plan: safety/regression evals on a small PHI sample they will provide.
sam_modelops: Can we get customer's sample into staging? We need signed DPA/BAA before we touch PHI. I'll open an RWO and schedule canary once paperwork done.
jordan_se: I'll draft the onboarding checklist and runbook for the enablement call. Sharing internal ops link: https://redwood-internal/ops/onboarding-checklist
intake_bot: New intake created: #INC-28934 - NewCo doc-summarizer. Assigned to sam_modelops. ETA initial benchmark 3 business days.
mia_cs: :thumbsup: Next steps: sam confirms hardware/cost estimate + acceptance criteria; jordan to schedule enablement call and share prompt set for quality gating. I'll flag renewal risk in CRM.
sam_modelops: Quick prelim estimate: int8 quant + 3x A100-40GB equiv with request-level batching should meet 250ms p95 for single-doc summarization at steady QPS. FP16-only will increase infra cost ~2.5x. I'll post a concise cost/latency table after smoke run and attach test artifacts.
lee_pm: Also record compliance ask: log retention 90 days. I'll loop legal for contract addendum.
jordan_se: I'll prep customer-facing summary and runbook, ping legal & security for the checklist
